caveats: causal_evidence cites trace/predicate evidence pointers only; it is not causal inference.
failure_type reuses an existing classifier label as a diagnostic label; it is not a canonical mechanism attribution without trace review.
failure_diagnosis records are deterministic diagnostics adapted from trace predicates; they make no benchmark-ranking, causal-validity, or correction-quality claim.
causal_evidence cites trace/predicate evidence pointers only; it is not causal inference.
Learned/LLM diagnosis generation, correction-usefulness scoring, and campaign-level diagnosis-quality claims are out of scope for this schema version.
